flashcards.back: NuGet is best understood as a set of boundaries, lifecycle rules, and failure modes—not a list of APIs. Trace one request or unit of work through those boundaries.
Reproduce narrowly and inspect the first incorrect state.
Measure the constrained resource before changing the design.
Treat input and identity as untrusted until validated at a boundary.
